clubs.title: Choose your Club
clubs.intro: You manage one Club, Season after Season. Choosing starts a new career and replaces the one you have running.

season.playoffsLost: Out of the playoffs in round {round}.
season.assistantDecides: Draft your prospects and set your call-ups and releases, or leave them to your assistant.
season.noFixture: Your Club has no Fixture left.

errors.noFixture: That Fixture has no result yet.

errors.unknownAdvance: That is not a way to advance.
errors.advanceFailed: The Season did not move on. Refresh the page and try again.

errors.seasonNotOver: The Season has no champion yet.

errors.noRosterFile: This server has no roster file.

playoffs.notYet: The playoffs start after the regular Season.

roster.notOurs: That Player is not on your Roster.

lineup.sparesHelp: Pick a slot above, then a Player here to bring them in.
lineup.help: Click one Player, then another, and they trade places. Nothing changes until you save. Injuries can leave a Skater out of position: this is marked, and you can rearrange around it at an intermission.
lineup.saved: Saved. It counts from your next Fixture.
lineup.assistantHelp: Your assistant coach picks the best Lineup from the fit Players. Your Tactics stay, and nothing counts until you save.
lineup.fatigueHelp: Energy, 100 for a fully rested Skater. It falls during play, and tired Skaters lose their attack first. It recovers a little at the intermissions.

aggressionEffect.low: You sit back: fewer shots both ways and fewer penalties.
aggressionEffect.mid: A balance of pressure and structure.
aggressionEffect.high: You press: more shots for you, more against you, and more penalties.

shotVolumeEffect.low: Fewer shots, but from better chances.
shotVolumeEffect.mid: A mix of good chances and volume.
shotVolumeEffect.high: Many shots, more of them from distance.

shiftLengthEffect.low: Players stay out longer and tire faster. Matchups work better.
shiftLengthEffect.high: Fresher legs, but matchups work less well.

tactics.matchupHelp: Who you send out against whom. It works at home only, where you have the last change, and matched Shifts tire your Players more.
tactics.exploitHelp: Your first Line hunts their weaker Pairing. More points for your top Line.
tactics.shutdownHelp: Your best defensive units face their first Line, and hold it back.
tactics.rotationHelp: When your backup starts instead of your starter. It does not apply in the playoffs.
tactics.restOnBackToBack: Rest the Goalie who played yesterday

live.help: You can change Tactics and the Lineup. Only dressed Players can take part, and nothing already played can change.
live.pending: Your change is ready. It counts from the next Shift once play goes on.

prematch.title: Before the Fixture
prematch.help: Set your Lineup and Tactics. Starting the Fixture saves them.

injuries.title: Injured Players in your Lineup: {count}
injuries.help: They cannot play. If you do nothing, the next Fixture replaces them automatically, but you can set it yourself.

notices.recovered: is fit again and can play.
notices.empty: Nothing yet. News about your Club arrives here.
notices.injuryBrief: was hurt, but misses no further Fixture.
notices.unsigned: was not signed again and left the league.
notices.rightsExpired: is no longer your prospect: his rights expired.
notices.calledUp: was called up to the Roster.

draft.title: Draft before Season {year}
draft.help: Prospects are shown as ranges: an 18-year-old’s future is still open.
draft.yourPick: You are on the clock: pick {pick}, round {round}
draft.leaveRest: Leave the rest to the assistant
draft.byGroup: Levels compare only within a position group: a Goalie’s scale is not a Skater’s.

moves.title: Roster moves before Season {year}
moves.ownHelp: These are your own moves. The assistant’s are a click away.
moves.assistantHelp: These are the assistant’s moves. Change them and save to make them yours.
moves.gaps: Places to fill, left by Players who went: {positions}. Gaps you leave are filled from undrafted Players.
moves.saved: Saved. They are made as the next Season starts.

violation.aboveShape: {count} {group} is more than the {shape} a Roster holds.
violation.cannotDress: With these moves the Club could not dress a Lineup.
